objective: Determine whether this Codex plugin is ready for release and identify concrete blockers with file-level evidence.
review-lenses: Plugin packaging and manifest correctness, including install, update, cache, and discovery behavior
Security boundaries, untrusted input handling, path containment, permissions, and destructive operations
Workflow contracts, dependency correctness, failure propagation, cancellation, retries, and persisted state
Skill instructions, product behavior, documentation accuracy, and mismatch between advertised and implemented capabilities
Test quality, missing adversarial cases, false-green risks, and runtime behavior not exercised by tests
Release engineering, version consistency, changelog accuracy, portability, and clean-install behavior
release-criteria: No critical or high-confidence high-severity defects; plugin manifest and packaged assets validate; documented commands match runtime behavior; security boundaries fail closed; tests cover core success and failure paths.
